title: A tally is in euros unless told otherwise, and Tally.sum hands back the tally itself, so that a caller can go on adding to it
covers: a harmless change (accepts more) and a breaking one in the same entry
the backstop is skipped once the tool's own comparison found anything
note: billing resolves meterUsage with Tally.sum(...): it now resolves a Tally, and its test reads .cents of it.
